correctness.rationale: The curve is smooth genus 3 iff the specified discriminant condition by derivative/gcd. Cyclic degree-four birational transformation and genus-one involution quotient are explicit. Each of 9 Cartier entries for p7 and p11 follows from a finite multinomial sum; two independent standard-library programs verify them by different computations and exhaustively check all Fp^2 coefficients. Antidiagonal A/A and scalar B stable semilinear blocks make stable Frobenius rank exactly 2*[A!=0]+[B!=0], rather than assuming instantaneous rank equals p-rank. A prime-to-p elliptic/Prym isogeny proves additive p-rank and a-number; a(P)=2 gives superspecial abelian surface. The parameter factors have no multiple roots on smooth domain, rank-at-most-one ideal p11 is reduced while Hasse rank-at-most-two ideal is not. Both programs successfully replayed from actual candidate files.
